mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings forecasts, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate robust consumer demand expansion, elevating corporate profit expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 rise, or the interaction term in a regression of SPX returns on HOUST and GDPC1 is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), rising inflation erodes real corporate earnings and triggers aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output above 90.0 (INDPRO) indicates strong industrial capacity utilization that supports corporate production and profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 90.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 500.0 thousand units (HOUST) reflect strong consumer demand for dwellings, accelerating construction sector growth and boosting retail sales, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 500.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Employment growth exceeding 130,000 thousand (PAYEMS > 130000.0) signals robust labor market conditions that sustain consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in consumer credit (RSAFS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate expanding household purchasing power that accelerates retail sales and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both RSAFS and GDPC1 rise, or the interaction term in a regression of SPX returns on RSAFS and GDPC1 is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
